findings.description: Bundle.locale is set to chain[0], the normalised tag. If a caller passes e.g. 'pt_br' or 'pt-br', the bundle locale becomes 'pt-BR', so this works. But Bundle can also be constructed directly, and more importantly missing_report groups by the normalised locale. The comparison itself is consistent for build_bundle output; the real problem is that the Bundle.locale changes from the requested value to a normalised one, which breaks callers that look up bundles by the original string. The original code kept locale=locale.
findings.suggestion: Keep the caller's locale in Bundle.locale, or document and update callers to use the normalised tag.
findings.title: fallback_keys compares source against raw requested locale, not the normalised one

findings.description: The previous code fetched all keys with a single catalog.get_many(locale, wanted). The new code calls catalog.exists and then catalog.get for every key in every locale of the chain, which is up to 2 calls per key per locale. If the catalog is backed by a DB or file, this is an N+1 pattern and doubles the lookups on hits.
findings.suggestion: Use catalog.get_many per locale on the remaining unresolved keys, walking down the chain.
findings.title: Per-key catalog lookups replace the batched get_many call
